connector.name: MCP by foura.ai
connector.registryDescription: Reliable web access for AI agents: smart HTTP, rotating proxies, and full-browser rendering.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.foura.ai over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace ai.foura, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
